## Checklist

- [ ] The document follows the template and writing guidelines in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] The table of contents links work and match the section headings
- [ ] Every footnote marker (`[^n]`) has a matching definition, and vice versa
- [ ] Placeholders such as `[VULNERABLE-SERVICE]` and `[ATTACKER-DOMAIN]` are used instead of real targets
- [ ] No real credentials, tokens, personal data, or private information are included
- [ ] External references are linked with a descriptive title
- [ ] For a new document, it is added to the table of contents in [README.md](../README.md)
